entries.proposition: Genetic loss of Cdk7 confined to postmitotic cortical glutamatergic neurons (Nex-Cre) reduced brain weight and thinned cortex and corpus callosum at P21.
entries.snippet: Besides striking size and weight differences, the thickness of the cortex and the corpus callosum (CC) were significantly reduced in P21 Cdk7-cKO compared to Ctrl brains (Fig. 2a-e).
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 is required for the morphological maturation

entries.proposition: Statistics of the thickness and density measures are one-sided Mann-Whitney tests on three animals per genotype, where P = 0.05 is the smallest value the test can return.
entries.snippet: n = 7-8 animals per genotype (b), n = 3 animals per genotype (d, e, g, h, j, k, p)

entries.proposition: Neuron number and layer markers were unchanged: the thinning is attributed to neurite loss rather than neuron loss.
entries.snippet: These data suggest that the cortical thinning observed in Cdk7-cKO brains is not related to defects in migration or survival.
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 is required for the morphological maturation

entries.proposition: Dendritic length and branching fall in layer II/III neurons in vivo; the n is 30 neurons from 3 animals per genotype.
entries.snippet: We performed Golgi-Cox impregnation to label dendrites [32] and observed a significant reduction of the total dendritic length and branching in Cdk7-cKO cortical neurons (Fig. 2l-n).
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 is required for the morphological maturation

entries.proposition: Behaviour: only social measures differ; marble burying, T-maze, open field and novel-object tests are reported as non-different, with 5-7 animals per group in the object test.
entries.snippet: Altogether, Cdk7-deficient mice exhibited normal locomotor activity and memory function, lacked repetitive behaviors but exhibited atypical social behaviors, including limited social olfaction and a lack of sociability.
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7-deficient mice exhibit social deficits

entries.proposition: Only 4 of the 7 Wnt5a-pathway genes tested by RT-qPCR reach P below 0.05 (one-sided tests, no multiplicity correction); Wnt5a itself is reported with P = 0.0601.
entries.snippet: Out of the 7 dysregulated genes tested, 5 showed consistent downregulation by RT-qPCR, including 4 that reached statistical significance
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 loss partially alters Wnt5a signaling

entries.proposition: The pharmacological arm: the CDK7 inhibitor YKL-5-124 is said to cause a rapid and important decrease of Wnt5a transcript, supported by a supplementary panel.
entries.snippet: We treated cortical neurons at DIV5 with YKL-5–124, a specific Cdk7 inhibitor [13], and observed a rapid and important decrease of Wnt5a transcript, suggesting that Cdk7 may directly controls its expression (Supplementary Fig. 8).
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 loss partially alters Wnt5a signaling

entries.proposition: The supplementary legend for the YKL-5-124 panel states one or two technical replicates per condition from two dams, with SD bars.
entries.snippet: n = 1-2 technical replicate(s) per condition from two biologically independent dams.

entries.proposition: Wnt5a rescue: 100 ng/mL raised total neurite length by 52.4 percent in Cdk7-KO neurons and 50 ng/mL did not (two doses; one effective).
entries.snippet: We observed an increase of 52.4% in total neuritic length in Cdk7-KO neurons treated with Wnt5a at 100 ng/mL (Fig. 6b, c). Of note, the rescue was only partial.
entries.anchor: Results / Cdk7 loss partially alters Wnt5a signaling

entries.proposition: Dunn comparison for the 50 ng/mL arm against vehicle is not significant (P above 0.9999), so a dose threshold cannot be located from two doses.
entries.snippet: PCre−GFP + Vehicle vs. Cre−GFP + Wnt5a 50 ng/mL > 0.9999

entries.proposition: The authors frame the Wnt5a pathway as a new therapeutic target for neuritogenesis disorders; this is a discussion statement, not a tested intervention in vivo.
entries.snippet: This pathway may thus constitute a new therapeutic target for patients suffering from neurodevelopmental disorders associated with altered neuritogenesis.

entries.proposition: The authors state the canonical/non-canonical Wnt distinction: canonical signalling sets progenitor pools and layer identity, Wnt5a acts on postmitotic morphology.
entries.snippet: On the other hand, non-canonical Wnt signaling (PCP & Wnt/Calcium Pathways) controls neuronal morphogenesis and maturation through ligands such as Wnt5a and Wnt7a

entries.proposition: Cdk7 and cyclin H Western blots rest on a single sample per age and genotype.
entries.snippet: Cdk7 and cyclin H western Blot experiments were carried out on one sample per age and per genotype.
entries.anchor: Methods / Protein extraction and Western blots

entries.proposition: No change in RNA polymerase II Ser5 phosphorylation was seen in Cdk7-cKO brains (data not shown), attributed to compensation.
entries.snippet: Accordingly, we could not detect in Cdk7-cKO brains any change in the phosphorylation level of Ser5 residues of the CTD, the main residues by which Cdk7 is thought to activate transcription (data not shown).
